lineage.reuse_policy: Preserve E0-E3 directness/perturbation distinctions. Grades refer to frozen support for reflexive methodological and computational claims themselves. The E2/E3 grades of source-study relations appearing inside RFX11A must NOT be copied onto RFX11A. This rubric is not a population-wide truth-quality scale and is not interchangeable with the PVS empirical-source profile.

E0.label: DECLARATION_OR_INFERENTIAL_BOUNDARY
E0.rule: A method, scope, negative entailment, or ontology/logic limitation is defined or inferred without a direct test in frozen evidence for that exact claim relation. E0 does not imply falsehood or low quality.

E1.label: DIRECT_NONINTERVENTIONAL_FROZEN_WITNESS
E1.rule: The frozen repository authority directly reports a concrete audit, count, observed mapping, source-review state, or analogous noninterventional diagnostic relevant to this exact reflexive relation. E1 does not mean an independent scientific replication.

E2.label: DIRECT_DECLARED_INTERVENTIONAL_CONTROL
E2.rule: Frozen evidence directly reports an explicitly declared perturbation or destructive manipulation of the target representation or criterion and its outcome for this same tested relation; a merely held-out test of an unchanged carrier is not automatically an intervention.

E3.label: EXPLICIT_REPEATED_COMPARABLE_INTERVENTIONS
E3.rule: E2 is met and frozen evidence explicitly demonstrates confirmation across multiple comparable interventions or target contexts for the SAME target relation; the presence of multiple heterogeneous control categories alone is insufficient. No E3 claim is presumed.

negative_claim_rule: A documented NOT_ESTABLISHED state is evidence for an explicit reporting/qualification boundary, not evidence proving no agreement or that a method can never work.
relation_unit: (self_target_id, ClaimIR relation id) from exact frozen 47-target candidate packet; do not collapse relations or infer grading from overall source-paper experimental methods.
claim_aggregation: Report relation-level min and max (E0<E1<E2<E3); do not compute a single claim evidence score.
freezing: Profile may be drafted only after this rubric is committed. Lock exact evidence artifact blob SHAs and per-relation provenance locators before layered decomposition or Grammar fit.
forbidden: Use manuscript self-description as independent evidence of its empirical success
Infer E2/E3 grade merely because a reflexive claim discusses PVS source E2/E3 relations
Treat retrospective v2 AHV-8 calibration as independent v2 held-out validation
Treat author review as independent extractor agreement
Infer causal experimental evidence solely from deterministic computational comparisons
Inspect or optimize reflexive Grammar fit, layered mapping, or reconstruction before evidence profile is frozen
Assign E3 from eight heterogeneous controls without multiple comparable interventions supporting the exact same relation
Change frozen source ClaimIR, B_P2, Phi, Grammar v0, Archetype identities, or review decisions
stage_exit: Freeze annotated profile and deterministic evidence-only validation; stop without reflexive layered/mapping/verdict. A subsequent issue/commit may initiate stage D.
